description_en: Removes tags from the specified Elastic Container Instance (ECI) resources
description_zh: 调用UntagResources为指定的ECI资源解绑标签
kebab_example: aliyun eci untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id '["eci-2zelg8vwnlzdhf8hv****"]' --resource-type ContainerGroup --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the resource belongs
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The keys of the tags that you want to remove. You can specify up to 20 tag keys
parameters.help_zh: 要解绑的标签键列表。最多可输入20个标签键
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

ContainerGroup: Elastic Container Instance.
ImageCache: image cache.
DataCache: data cache.
VirtualNode: virtual node
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值范围：

ContainerGroup：ECI实例
ImageCache：镜像缓存
DataCache：数据缓存
VirtualNode：虚拟节点
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the resources. This parameter takes effect only when the TagKey parameter is not specified in the request. Valid values:

true: Removes all tags from the resources.
false: Does not remove all tags from the resources.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否解绑资源上全部的标签。当请求中未设置 `TagKey`时，该参数才有效。取值范围：

true
false

默认值：false
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
